local INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS = {
    [1] = { quas = 1, wex = 1, exort = 1 },
    [2] = { quas = 2, wex = 2, exort = 2 },
    [3] = { quas = 3, wex = 3, exort = 3 },
    [4] = { quas = 4, wex = 4, exort = 4 },
    [5] = { quas = 5, wex = 5, exort = 5 },
    [6] = { quas = 7, wex = 7, exort = 7 },
}

local INVOKER_COMBOS = {
    invoker_cold_snap = "quas quas quas",
    invoker_ghost_walk = "quas quas wex",
    invoker_ice_wall = "quas quas exort",
    invoker_emp = "wex wex wex",
    invoker_tornado = "quas wex wex",
    invoker_alacrity = "wex wex exort",
    invoker_sun_strike = "exort exort exort",
    invoker_chaos_meteor = "wex exort exort",
    invoker_forge_spirit = "quas exort exort",
    invoker_deafening_blast = "quas wex exort",
}

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    if (not quas) or (not wex) or (not exort) or (not invoke) then
        print(string.format(
            "[InvokerHandler][EnsureOrbs] missing ability (quas=%s,wex=%s,exort=%s,invoke=%s) dummy=%s lvl=%s",
            tostring(quas), tostring(wex), tostring(exort), tostring(invoke),
            tostring(context.parent and context.parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(context.dummy_level)
        ))
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

local InvokerHandler = {}

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort then
        return false
    end

    if not invoke then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if slot == profile.projectile_name then
                return false
            end
        end
    end

    local function QueueOrb(orb, count)
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    QueueOrb(quas, combo.quas or 0)
    QueueOrb(wex, combo.wex or 0)
    QueueOrb(exort, combo.exort or 0)

    if invoke then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = invoke:entindex(),
            Queue = true,
        })
    end

    if state then
        AddToSlots(state, profile.projectile_name)
    end

    return true
end

return InvokerHandler

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
    }

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
            profile.follow_facing = tostring(profile.skill_kv.AutoCastFollowFacing or "") == "1"
            profile.ability_duration = ParseAbilityDuration(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)

        return self:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    end)

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()
        local enemy_pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        local dist = (enemy_pos - clone_pos):Length2D()
        local atk_range = clone:Script_GetAttackRange()
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack]", clone:GetUnitName(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "Distance", dist, "AtkRange",
            atk_range)
        local attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = clone:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, clone, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        if clone.RemoveGesture then
            clone:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
        end
        if clone.StartGesture then
            clone:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_ATTACK)
        end
        clone:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack] After", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "IsAttacking",
            clone.IsAttacking and clone:IsAttacking())
    else
        local ab = clone:FindAbilityByName(profile.projectile_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
            if ab then
                ab:SetLevel(1)
                ab:SetActivated(true)
            end
        end
        if not ab then
            return nil
        end


        if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Position = pos,
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local ttl = 0
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.GetSpecialValueFor then
            local dur = profile.skill:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
            if dur and dur > 0 then
                ttl = dur
            end
        end
        if ttl <= 0 then
            ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
        end
        self.clone_pause_until = math.max(self.clone_pause_until or 0, GameRules:GetGameTime() + ttl)
        self:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    end

    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local offset = 0
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
        self:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then
        return 0.05
    end

    local clone_active = self:IsCloneActive()
    local clone_available = clone_active and not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
    if clone_active and not clone_available then
        DebugClone("[CloneBusy] use base", profile.projectile_name, GameRules:GetGameTime())
    end
    if IsUnitBusy(clone_available and self.clone_unit or self.parent) then
        return 0.1
    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)
    local use_clone = clone_available or profile.dummy_mode == "clone"

      if profile.behavior == "Self" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, self.owner, self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), interval) or self.parent
          else
              ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                  UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
                  OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                  AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
                  TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                  Queue = false,
              })
          end
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
          profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
          return interval
      end

    local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
    if profile.dummy_mode ~= "clone" and clone_available and self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        origin = self.clone_unit:GetAbsOrigin()
    end
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

    local cast_range = 0
    if not profile.is_attack and (profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target") then
        cast_range = GetAbilityCastRange(profile, origin, self.owner)
        if cast_range > 0 then
            range = math.min(range, cast_range)
        end
    end

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.behavior == "NoTarget" or profile.is_attack then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            return 0.1
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end
    end

    if profile.behavior == "Position" and pos and cast_range and cast_range > 0 then
        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist > cast_range then
            local final = math.max(cast_range - 25, 0)
            pos = origin + dir:Normalized() * final
        end
    end

    if profile.is_attack then
        if use_clone then
            self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
            profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
            return interval
        end
        local attrs_mod = self.attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then

            self.attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, self.parent, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        self.parent.__autocast_attack_profile = profile
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")

        self.parent:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    if pos and not use_clone then
        self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)
    end

      if profile.behavior == "Position" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),

              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
          if profile.follow_facing then
              profile.follow_facing_active = true
              profile.follow_facing_pos = pos
              profile.follow_facing_target = enemy
              if profile.ability_duration and profile.ability_duration > 0 then
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = now + profile.ability_duration
            else
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = nil
            end
        end
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then

          local caster = self.parent
          if use_clone then

              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,

          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)

              profile.follow_facing_pos = pos
              profile.follow_facing_target = enemy

      elseif profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then

        end
        return nil
    end

        if profile.projectile_name == ability_name then
            return profile
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
local autocast_item_config = require("projectiles.autocast_item_config")



modifier_item_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.lvl          = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
        self.custom_level = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

        local raw_kv = raw_kv_withlevel
        if raw_kv_withlevel and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetOverrideValues and ability.raw_name then
            local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
            local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name]
            local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level, base_item_kv)
            if overrides then
                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
                for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                    if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                        raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                    else
                        raw_kv[key] = value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.hero_name       = raw_kv.HeroName
        self.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then
            return
        end

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveLevel)
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSPLevel, "[HeroPassiveSP]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp_2 = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp_2, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2Level, "[HeroPassiveSP2]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, nil, self.hero_modifier_sp, {})
            if self.mod then
                print("[Hero Modifier SP]", self.mod:GetName())
            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then
            self.skill_pure_percent = BpToRatio(tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent))
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage then
            self.skill_base_damage = tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage or 0) or 0
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

        self.skill_listener = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_item_cast_listener", {
            ability_name = self.skill,
            dummy_index = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex(),
            level = self.skill_level,
            pure_percent = self.skill_pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    local dummy_name = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. self.lvl
    print(string.format("[CreateDummy] hero=%s lvl=%s dummy=%s", tostring(self.hero_name), tostring(self.lvl),
        tostring(dummy_name)))
    self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
        dummy_name,
        Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
        false,
        parent,
        parent,
        parent:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not self.dummy then
        print(string.format("[CreateDummy][Error] failed to spawn %s for hero=%s lvl=%s", tostring(dummy_name),
            tostring(self.hero_name), tostring(self.lvl)))
        return
    end

    self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local dummy_level = Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(tonumber(self.lvl)) or 1

    if dummy_level > 1 then
        dummy_level = dummy_level - 1
        self.dummy:CreatureLevelUp(dummy_level)
    end

    if self.hero_name == "invoker" then
        print(string.format("[CreateDummy] invoker dummy_level=%d model=%s", dummy_level + 1,
            tostring(self.dummy:GetModelName())))
    end

    if self.pid and self.slot then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid].Slots[self.slot].Dummy = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()
        local pos = Shop1Managers[self.pid] and Shop1Managers[self.pid]:GetGoodPointPos(self.slot)
        if not pos then
            local point = EntIndexToHScript(self.slot)
            if point then
                pos = point:GetOrigin()
            end
        end
        if pos then
            self.dummy:SetOrigin(pos)
        end
    end

    self.dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    self:EnsureStarWorldPanel()

    -- self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        hero_name                   = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                 = self.dummy:GetLevel(),
        projectile_name             = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level            = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval         = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range            = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage      = self.projectile_base_damage,
        heal_percent                = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode       = self.projectile_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp               = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level         = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval      = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range         = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage   = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode    = self.projectile_sp_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level       = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval    = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range       = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode  = self.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode,

        passive_name                = self.passive_name,
        passive_level               = self.passive_level,

        passive_sp                  = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level            = self.passive_sp_level,

        passive_sp_2                = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level          = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                  = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                 = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                = self.lifesteal_sp,
        additional_projectiles      = self.extra_projectiles,
        additional_passives         = self.additional_passives,
    })
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummySP(parent, ability)
    self.dummy_sp = CreateUnitByName(
        "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp",
        self.dummy:GetOrigin(),
        false,
        parent,
        parent,
        parent:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not self.dummy_sp then return end

    self.dummy_sp:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy_sp:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)

    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(self.dummy_sp, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

    -- print("[Dummy SP]")

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    self.dummy_sp:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        projectile_name        = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_interval    = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_range       = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        passive_name           = self.passive_name,
        heal_percent           = self.HealPercent,
        pure_percent           = self.PurePercent,
        ability_sp             = self.ability_sp,
        lifesteal_sp           = self.lifesteal_sp,
        passive_sp             = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level       = self.passive_sp_level,
        modifier_sp            = self.modifier_sp,
    })
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        self.dummy_sp:Destroy()
        self.dummy_sp = nil
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanel()
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    if not WorldPanels then
        return
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    local level = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1, 6))
    local stars = string.rep("★", level)

    -- print(string.format("[WorldPanel Debug] Creating Panel: Level=%d, Unit=%s, Stars=%s", level, self.dummy:GetUnitName(), stars))

    self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/shop1_dummy_level.xml",
        entity = self.dummy,
        entityHeight = 100,
        horizontalAlign = "center",
        verticalAlign = "bottom",
        offsetY = -25,
        data = {
            stars = stars,
            level = level,
        },
    })

    if not self.worldPanel then
        print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
    end
end

        cfg.level = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Level"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "Interval"] then
        cfg.interval = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Interval"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "Range"] then
        cfg.range = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Range"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "BaseDamage"] then
        cfg.base_damage = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "BaseDamage"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"] and raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"] ~= "" then
        cfg.pure_percent = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"]))
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "DummyMode"] then
        cfg.dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw[prefix .. "DummyMode"])
    end

    return cfg
end

local function ReadSPSlot(raw, idx)
    local suffix = (idx == 1) and "" or tostring(idx)
    local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
    local slot = ReadProjectileBlock(raw, prefix)
    if not slot then
        return nil
    end

    if slot.interval == nil then
        slot.interval = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Interval"])
    end
    if slot.range == nil then
        slot.range = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Range"])
    end
    if slot.base_damage == nil then
        slot.base_damage = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "BaseDamage"])
    end
    if slot.pure_percent == nil and raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"] then
        slot.pure_percent = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"]))
    end
    if slot.dummy_mode == nil then
        slot.dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw[prefix .. "DummyMode"])
    end

    return slot
end

function M.Read(raw_kv)
    local cfg = {}
    if not raw_kv then
        return cfg
    end

    cfg.hero_name = raw_kv.HeroName

    cfg.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName
    if raw_kv.ProjectileLevel then
        cfg.projectile_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.ProjectileLevel)
    end

    local values = raw_kv.AbilityValues or {}
    cfg.projectile_interval = common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileInterval)
    cfg.projectile_range = common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileRange)
    cfg.projectile_base_damage = common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileBaseDamage)

    if not cfg.projectile_interval or cfg.projectile_interval <= 0 then
        cfg.projectile_interval = 2.0
    end
    if not cfg.projectile_range or cfg.projectile_range <= 0 then
        cfg.projectile_range = 800
    end

    if raw_kv.HealPercent and raw_kv.HealPercent ~= "" then
        cfg.heal_percent = BpToRatio(raw_kv.HealPercent)
    end
    if raw_kv.PurePercent and raw_kv.PurePercent ~= "" then
        cfg.pure_percent = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PurePercent))
    end

    local function apply_slot_defaults(slot)
        if not slot then
            return nil
        end
        if slot.interval == nil then
            slot.interval = 2
        end
        if slot.range == nil then
            slot.range = 800
        end
        if slot.base_damage == nil then
            slot.base_damage = 0
        end
        return slot
    end

    cfg.extra_projectiles = {}

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local slot = ReadSPSlot(raw_kv, i)
        if slot then
            slot = apply_slot_defaults(slot)
            if i == 1 then
                cfg.projectile_sp = slot.name
                cfg.projectile_sp_level = slot.level
                cfg.projectile_sp_interval = slot.interval
                cfg.projectile_sp_range = slot.range
                cfg.projectile_sp_base_damage = slot.base_damage
                cfg.projectile_sp_purePercent = slot.pure_percent
                cfg.projectile_sp_dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode
            elseif i == 2 then
                cfg.projectile_sp_2 = slot.name
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_level = slot.level
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_interval = slot.interval
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_range = slot.range
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_base_damage = slot.base_damage
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_purePercent = slot.pure_percent
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode
            else
                table.insert(cfg.extra_projectiles, {
                    name = slot.name,
                    level = slot.level,
                    interval = slot.interval,
                    range = slot.range,
                    base_damage = slot.base_damage,
                    pure_percent = slot.pure_percent,
                    dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    cfg.passive_name = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.PassiveName)
    cfg.passive_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PassiveLevel)
    cfg.passive_sp = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.PassiveSP)
    cfg.passive_sp_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PassiveSPLevel)
    cfg.passive_sp_2 = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.PassiveSP2)
    cfg.passive_sp_2_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PassiveSP2Level)
    cfg.additional_passives = {}
    for i = 3, 6 do
        local suffix = tostring(i)
        local name = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv["PassiveSP" .. suffix])
        if name and name ~= "" and name ~= "none" then
            table.insert(cfg.additional_passives, {
                name = name,
                level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv["PassiveSP" .. suffix .. "Level"]),
            })
        end
    end

    cfg.projectile_dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ProjectileDummyMode)
    cfg.projectile_sp_dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ProjectileSPDummyMode)
    cfg.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ProjectileSP2DummyMode)

    cfg.ability_sp = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.AbilitySP)
    cfg.modifier_sp = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ModifierSP)

    if raw_kv.LifestealSP and common.ToNumber(raw_kv.LifestealSP) and common.ToNumber(raw_kv.LifestealSP) > 0 then
        cfg.lifesteal_sp = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw_kv.LifestealSP))
    end

    return cfg
end

(file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
### How to use skills
- Discovery: The list above is the skills available in this session (name + description + file path). Skill bodies live on disk at the listed paths.
- Trigger rules: If the user names a skill (with `$SkillName` or plain text) OR the task clearly matches a skill's description shown above, you must use that skill for that turn. Multiple mentions mean use them all. Do not carry skills across turns unless re-mentioned.
- Missing/blocked: If a named skill isn't in the list or the path can't be read, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.
- How to use a skill (progressive disclosure):
  1) After deciding to use a skill, open its `SKILL.md`. Read only enough to follow the workflow.
  2) If `SKILL.md` points to extra folders such as `references/`, load only the specific files needed for the request; don't bulk-load everything.
  3) If `scripts/` exist, prefer running or patching them instead of retyping large code blocks.
  4) If `assets/` or templates exist, reuse them instead of recreating from scratch.
- Coordination and sequencing:
  - If multiple skills apply, choose the minimal set that covers the request and state the order you'll use them.
  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.
- Context hygiene:
  - Keep context small: summarize long sections instead of pasting them; only load extra files when needed.
  - Avoid deep reference-chasing: prefer opening only files directly linked from `SKILL.md` unless you're blocked.
  - When variants exist (frameworks, providers, domains), pick only the relevant reference file(s) and note that choice.
- Safety and fallback: If a skill can't be applied cleanly (missing files, unclear instructions), state the issue, pick the next-best approach, and continue.

**可定位的方案（按优先级）**
- **A. 二分隔离触发点（不改逻辑，只短路）**  
  在 `modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy` 里用临时开关分段 return：  
  1) 只 `CreateUnitByName`，不加任何 modifier  
  2) 只加 `modifier_phased` / `modifier_rooted`  
  3) 再加 `modifier_dummy_autocast`  
  如果在 1/2 就断，问题是单位定义或基础 modifier；如果在 3 断，问题是 `modifier_dummy_autocast:OnCreated` 的某段逻辑。
- **B. 二分隔离 `modifier_dummy_autocast:OnCreated`**  
  先 return 在 `InitProjectileProfile` 之前，若不崩，再逐步放开：  
  1) 只建主技能 projectile  
  2) 再加 SP / SP2  
  3) 再加 `additional_projectiles` / `additional_passives`  
  这样能快速锁定是哪一组数据触发崩溃。
- **C. 引擎崩溃捕获（不是 log）**  
  用 `-condebug` 启动，把 `console.log` 保留下来。断线时如果是 server crash，一般会留下更底层的提示。  
  如果你能开 `-vconsole`，崩溃前的 native 错误更完整。
- **D. 验证实体/单位定义是否异常**  
  你之前出现过 `npc_dota_base teamnumber=4294967295`，这像是单位 KV 解析异常或 CreateUnit 回落到 base。

选一个：

你给的示例代码本身 **不会闪退**：  
`A()` → `B()` 里先把 `a = true`，再回调 `A()`，第二次 `A()` 看到 `a` 为真就 return 了，所以递归被正确切断。  
**所以真正的闪退说明：你的真实流程里“防重入”不是这样工作的** —— 要么防重入没设、设得太晚、或者每个对象各有一份 flag（相当于两个 A/B 各自递归，彼此挡不住），就会导致**重入/双重销毁**。

结合你现在的现象（只保留销毁两个 item，invoker 正在施法时合成仍闪退），最合理的原因是：

**核心原因（高概率）**
- **销毁链路发生重入**：  
  物品1销毁 → 触发移除 modifier/ability → 间接触发物品2销毁 → 物品2再回头触发物品1销毁（或同一个 modifier 的 OnDestroy 被再次触发）。  
  这个过程如果“防重入标记”是**每个实例一份**，就挡不住互相递归，最终出现**双重销毁 / double free**（引擎层面直接崩）。
- **正在施法时更容易触发**：  
  Invoker 施法期间有排队指令/ability phase/定时器，合成时销毁 dummy 或 modifier，会让引擎继续执行**已被销毁的实体/技能**，导致 native crash。  
  你之前日志出现过 `teamnumber=4294967295` 这类非法值，说明已经有实体生命周期异常/悬空指针迹象。

**为什么“正在施法的 invoker”更容易崩**
- 施法时有持续的 `ExecuteOrderFromTable`、计时器、或 ability phase 中的指令/回调；  
- 这时销毁 dummy / modifier / ability，等于在引擎还在用它时把它释放，尤其是 **invoker 这种需要连续排队多次技能** 的情况，极易触发引擎层崩溃。

**结论**
- 问题不是“合成添加 item”，而是 **销毁路径的重入/双重销毁 + 施法中销毁实体**。  
- 你给的示例代码表明：**只要防重入不一致或设得太晚，就会造成崩溃**；而当前合成逻辑就是这种“相互触发”的结构。

如果你后续允许我改代码，我会建议：
1) 对“合成销毁”做全局防重入/去重（不是每个实例一份）。  
2) 合成时先**停止施法 + 清空队列 + 延迟销毁**（比如延迟 0.03–0.1 秒）。  
3) 销毁逻辑做幂等处理（destroy once, ignore repeats）。

但按你当前要求：**问题分析已经给出根因方向** —— “销毁链路重入 + 施法中销毁实体导致 native crash”。

if Shop1Manager == nil then
    Shop1Manager = class({})
end

Shop1Managers = {}

Shop1Manager._event_registered = Shop1Manager._event_registered or false

Shop1Managers.debug = Shop1Managers.debug or false
Shop1Managers.motion_debug = Shop1Managers.motion_debug or false

Shop1Managers.level_map = { [1] = 1, [2] = 6, [3] = 12, [4] = 18, [5] = 24, [6] = 30 }
require("spawn_wall_manager")

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)
    local mgr
    if not Shop1Managers[pid] then
        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then
        mgr.Slots = {}
    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 购买请求
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(6, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local equipName = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, lvl)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    if name == "item_invoker_deafening_blast" and tonumber(lvl) == 6 then
        print(string.format("[Shop1] AddItem invoker lvl6 -> slot %s", tostring(slot)))
    end

    name = "item_invoker_deafening_blast"

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDragMotionParams()
    return {
        max_duration = 0.75,
        min_duration = 0.25,
        max_distance = 0,
        snap_distance = 1,
        max_height = 400,
        steps = 30,
    }
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 6 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                -- self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            self:RemoveItem(slotB)
            self.Slots[slotB] = -1

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                    -- self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
                else
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no equipName", slotMover, slotTarget)
                end
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no hero", slotMover, slotTarget)
            end
        end)
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataA, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    if moveBoth then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataB, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    end

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToSlot(data, slot, params, onFinish)
    local pos = self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    if not pos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    self:AnimateDataToPos(data, pos, params, onFinish)
end

function Shop1Manager:MoveDummyToSlot(data, slot)
    if not data or not slot then return end

    local pos = self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    if not pos then return end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end

    if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp and not data.Autocast.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        data.Autocast.dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindNearestGoodSlot(pos, radius)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local nearestSlot = nil
    local nearestDist = radius or 0

    for slot, pointPos in pairs(points) do
        local dist = (pointPos - pos):Length2D()
        if dist <= nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestSlot = slot
        end
    end

    return nearestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:HandleDummyDrag(dummy, targetPos, allowOccupied)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return false end

    local currentSlot, data = self:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not currentSlot or not data then return false end
    if data.Moving then return true end
    if allowOccupied == nil then allowOccupied = true end

    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("HandleDummyDrag", currentSlot, "allowOccupied", allowOccupied, "pos", targetPos.x,
        targetPos.y)

    local targetSlot = self:FindNearestGoodSlot(targetPos, 200)
    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    if not targetSlot then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    if targetSlot == currentSlot then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    local targetData = self.Slots[targetSlot]
    local isTargetEmpty = (not targetData or targetData == -1)
    if targetData and targetData ~= -1 and targetData.Moving then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, currentSlot, motion)
        return true
    end

    if isTargetEmpty then
        self.Slots[currentSlot] = -1
        self.Slots[targetSlot] = data
        if data.Autocast then
            data.Autocast.slot = targetSlot
        end
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, targetSlot, motion)
        return true
    end

    if allowOccupied and self:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(currentSlot, targetSlot, targetSlot, false) then
        return true
    end
    if not allowOccupied then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    self.Slots[currentSlot] = targetData
    self.Slots[targetSlot] = data

    if data.Autocast then
        data.Autocast.slot = targetSlot
    end
    if targetData.Autocast then
        targetData.Autocast.slot = currentSlot
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, targetSlot, motion)
    self:AnimateDataToSlot(targetData, currentSlot, motion)
    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:HandleSynthesizeByPID()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then return end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if hero then
        self:Synthesize(hero)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return
    end

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats

            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 6 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)

            return
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevelAll(hero, lvl)
    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats
            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 6 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)
    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then return end

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 6 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do
                local slotA = table.remove(points)
                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local stats = data.Stats

    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        stats:Destroy()
    end

    local autocast = data.Autocast

    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast:Destroy()
    end

    self.Slots[slot] = -1
end

function Shop1Manager:DestroyAllItems(hero)
    print("[Shop] DestroyAllItems")

    for key, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        self:RemoveItem(key)
    end
end

Shop1Manager.item_cache = {}

function Shop1Manager:RemoveAndStoreItems(hero)
    self.item_cache = {}

    for key, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if value and value.Stats then
            local stats = value.Stats
            if stats then
                local ability = stats:GetAbility()
                local level = stats.custom_level
                local name = nil
                if ability then
                    name = ability.raw_name or ability:GetAbilityName()
                    if name and level then
                        local suffix = "_" .. tostring(level)
                        if name:sub(-#suffix) == suffix then
                            name = name:sub(1, #name - #suffix)
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.insert(self.item_cache, { name = name, level = level })
                self:RemoveItem(key)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:ReAddItem(hero)
    for i, data in ipairs(self.item_cache) do
        self:AddItem(hero, data.name, data.level)
    end
end

    elseif type == 3 then
