SELECTION_VERSION = "1.00"

--[[
    Lua-controlled Selection Library by Noya
    
    Installation:
    - "require" this file inside your code in order to add the new API functions to the PlayerResource global
    - Additionally, ensure your game scripts custom_net_tables.txt has a "selection" entry
    - Finally, ensure that you have the following files correctly added and included in your panorama content folder
        selection.xml, and include line on custom_ui_manifest.xml, on layout/custom_game/ folder
        selection folder containing selection.js and selection_filter.js, on /scripts/ folder

    Usage:
    - Functions with unit_args can recieve an Entity Index, a NPC Handle, or a table of each type.
    - Functions with unit can recieve an Entity Index or NPC Handle

    * Create a new selection for the player
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)

    * Add units to the current selection of the player
        PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Remove units by index from the player selection group
        PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Returns the list of units by entity index that are selected by the player
        PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)

    * Deselect everything, selecting the main hero (which can be redirected to another entity)
        PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)

    * Get the index of the first selected unit of the player
        PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    
    * Check if a unit is selected or not by a player, returns bool
        PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit_args)

    * Force a refresh of the current selection on all players, useful after abilities are removed
        PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    
    * Redirects the selection of the main hero to another entity of choice
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    
    * Redirects the selection of any entity to another entity of choice
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)

    * Use -1 to reset to default
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, -1)
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(-1)

    Notes:
    - Enemy units that you don't control can't be added to the selection group of a player
    - This library requires "libraries/timers.lua" to be present in your vscripts directory.

--]]

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_new", {entities = entities})
    end
end 

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_add", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_remove", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_reset", {})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    return Selection.entities[playerID] or {}
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID) 
    return selectedEntities and selectedEntities["0"]
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then return false end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if not entIndex then return false end
    
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    for _,v in pairs(selectedEntities) do
        if v==entIndex then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        FireGameEvent("dota_player_update_selected_unit", {})
    end)
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then unit = -1 end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or unit:GetEntityIndex()
    local hero = self:GetSelectedHeroEntity(playerID)
    if hero then
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)
    end
end

function CDOTA_BaseNPC:SetSelectionOverride(reselect_unit)
    local unit = self
    local reselectIndex = type(reselect_unit)=="number" and reselect_unit or reselect_unit:GetEntityIndex()

    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("selection", tostring(unit:GetEntityIndex()), {entity = reselectIndex})
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Internal
------------------------------------------------------------------------

require('libraries/timers')

if not Selection then
    Selection = class({})
end

function Selection:Init()
    Selection.entities = {} --Stores the selected entities of each playerID
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("selection_update", Dynamic_Wrap(Selection, 'OnUpdate'))
end

function Selection:OnUpdate(event)
    local playerID = event.PlayerID
    Selection.entities[playerID] = event.entities

    if Selection.ignore_next and Selection.ignore_next[playerID] then
        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = nil
        return
    end

    if not Shop1Managers or not Shop1Managers[playerID] then
        return
    end

    local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
    local entities = event.entities or {}
    local ent = entities[1] or entities["0"]
    if not ent then
        for _, v in pairs(entities) do
            ent = v
            break
        end
    end
    if not ent then return end

    local unit = EntIndexToHScript(ent)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then return end

    if mgr.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager] Selection update", playerID, "ent", ent, unit:GetUnitName())
    end

    local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit)
    if not slot or not data then
        if not Selection.last_dummy then Selection.last_dummy = {} end
        Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = nil
        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
        if player then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", { ability = "" })
        end
        return
    end

    Selection.last_dummy = Selection.last_dummy or {}
    local last = Selection.last_dummy[playerID]
    Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = { slot = slot, ent = ent }

    -- When selecting another dummy, keep default behavior (just select new unit).

    local ability_name = ""
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local ability = data.Stats:GetAbility()
        if ability then
            ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
        end
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", {
            ability = ability_name
        })
    end
end

-- Internal function to build an entity index list out of various inputs
function Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
    local entities = {}
    if type(unit_args)=="number" then
        table.insert(entities, unit_args) -- Entity Index
    -- Check contents of the table
    elseif type(unit_args)=="table" then
        if unit_args.IsCreature then
            table.insert(entities, unit_args:GetEntityIndex()) -- NPC Handle
        else
            for _,arg in pairs(unit_args) do
                -- Table of entity index values
                if type(arg)=="number" then
                    table.insert(entities, arg)
                -- Table of npc handles
                elseif type(arg)=="table" then
                    if arg.IsCreature then
                        table.insert(entities, arg:GetEntityIndex())
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return entities
end

if not Selection.entities then Selection:Init() end

			end
			if slot then

				if targetSlot then
					if mgr.debug then

					end
					if mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, targetSlot, targetSlot, false) then
						return false
					end
					if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, target:GetAbsOrigin(), true) then
						return false
					end
				else
					if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, target:GetAbsOrigin(), false) then
						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Example 3: Disable item sharing for a custom courier that everyone can control
	--[[
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GIVE_ITEM then
		local unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])

			end

local function FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)
	if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local ability_name = damaging_ability and damaging_ability.GetAbilityName and damaging_ability:GetAbilityName() or nil
	local mods = attacker:FindAllModifiers()

	if mods then
		for _, mod in pairs(mods) do
			if mod and mod.GetName and mod:GetName() == "modifier_dummy_autocast" then
				if mod.GetProfileForAbilityName then
					local profile = mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
					if profile then
						return mod, profile
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local fallback = attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
	if fallback then
		local profile = fallback.GetProfileForAbilityName and fallback:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name) or nil
		return fallback, profile
	end

	return nil, nil
end

-- Damage filter function
function barebones:DamageFilter(keys)
	-- PrintTable(keys)

	local attacker
	local victim
	if keys.entindex_attacker_const and keys.entindex_victim_const then
		attacker = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_attacker_const)
		victim = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_victim_const)
	else
		return false
	end

	local original_attacker = attacker
	local original_victim = victim

	local inflictor = keys.entindex_inflictor_const -- nil if damage is not caused by an ability
	local damaging_ability = inflictor and EntIndexToHScript(inflictor) or nil
	local modifier_autocast, profile = FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)

	if modifier_autocast then
		if profile then
			if profile.hit_label ~= nil then
				victim.hit_label = profile.hit_label
			end

			if profile.base_damage ~= nil then
				victim.base_damage = profile.base_damage
			end

			if profile.pure_percent ~= nil then
				victim.pure_percent = profile.pure_percent
			end

			if profile.lifesteal ~= nil then
				victim.lifesteal = profile.lifesteal
			end
		end

		if modifier_autocast.attacker_override and not modifier_autocast.attacker_override._is_evolving and modifier_autocast.attacker_override:IsRealHero() then
			attacker = modifier_autocast.attacker_override
			victim.last_real_attacker = attacker
		end
	end

	-- Damage types:
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_NONE = 0
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL = 1
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL = 2
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE = 4
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_ALL = 7
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_HP_REMOVAL = 8

	-- Find the ability/item that dealt the dmg, if normal attack or no ability/item it will be nil
	-- damaging_ability resolved above

	if damaging_ability and damaging_ability._is_skill then
		local modifier_cast = original_attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_cast")

		if modifier_cast then
			print("[Filter]", modifier_cast:GetName(), modifier_cast.hit_label, modifier_cast.base_damage)
			if modifier_cast.hit_label then
				victim.hit_label = modifier_cast.hit_label
			end

			if modifier_cast.base_damage then
				victim.base_damage = modifier_cast.base_damage
			end

			if modifier_cast.pure_percent then
				victim.pure_percent = modifier_cast.pure_percent
			end

			if modifier_cast.attacker_override and not modifier_cast.attacker_override._is_evolving and modifier_cast.attacker_override:IsRealHero() then
				attacker = modifier_cast.attacker_override
				victim.last_real_attacker = attacker
			end
		end
	end

	local damage_type             = keys.damagetype_const
	local damage_after_reductions = keys.damage -- keys.damage is damage after reductions without spell amplifications

	-- Lack of entities handling (illusions error fix)
	if attacker:IsNull() or victim:IsNull() then
		return false
	end

	local victim_owner = victim:GetOwner()

	if victim_owner and victim_owner == attacker and damage_type == 0 and damaging_ability == nil then
		return false
	end

	keys.damage = damage_system:ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)

	if victim.transfer_damage then
		local new_victim = victim:GetOwner()
		if new_victim and not new_victim:IsNull() then
			ApplyDamage({
				attacker = attacker,
				victim = new_victim,
				damage = keys.damage,
				damage_type = keys.damagetype_const,
				ability = damaging_ability,
			})

			-- print("[Transfer Damage]", attacker:GetUnitName(), new_victim:GetUnitName(), keys.damage)

			return false
		end
	end

	-- Update the gold bounty of the hero before he dies
	if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_GOLD_BOUNTY then
		if attacker:IsControllableByAnyPlayer() and victim:IsRealHero() and not victim:IsSpiritBearCustom() and not victim:IsTempestDouble() and not victim:IsClone() and damage_after_reductions >= victim:GetHealth() then
			-- Get his killing streak
			local hero_streak = victim:GetStreak()
			-- Get his level
			local hero_level = victim:GetLevel()
			-- Adjust Gold bounty
			local gold_bounty
			if hero_streak > 2 then
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL +
					(hero_streak - 2) * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_STREAK
			else
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL
			end

			victim:SetMinimumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
			victim:SetMaximumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Healing Filter, can be used to modify how much hp regen and healing a unit is gaining
-- Triggers every time a unit gains health
function barebones:HealingFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local healing_target_index = keys.entindex_target_const
	local heal_amount = keys.heal -- heal amount of the ability or health restored with hp regen during server tick
	local healer_index = keys.entindex_healer_const
	local healing_ability_index = keys.entindex_inflictor_const

	local healing_target
	if healing_target_index then
		healing_target = EntIndexToHScript(healing_target_index)
	end

	-- Find the source of the heal - the healer
	local healer
	if healer_index then
		healer = EntIndexToHScript(healer_index)
	else
		healer = healing_target -- hp regen
	end

	-- Find healing ability
	-- Abilities that give bonus hp regen don't count as healing abilities!!!
	local healing_ability
	if healing_ability_index then
		healing_ability = EntIndexToHScript(healing_ability_index)
	end
	-- If healing_ability is nil then the 'source' of the heal is unit's hp regen

	if healing_ability then
		-- print("[Healing]", healing_ability, healing_ability._custom_heal, healing_ability:GetAbilityName(), heal_amount, healing_target:GetUnitName(), healing_target:GetPlayerOwnerID())

		if not healing_ability._custom_heal and healing_target:IsRealHero() then
			local modifier_autocast = healer:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")

			if modifier_autocast and modifier_autocast.heal_percent then
				healing_target.heal_percent = modifier_autocast.heal_percent
			end

			heal_amount = damage_system:ProcessHeal(healer, healing_target, keys)

-- Inventory filter, triggers every time a unit picks up or buys an item, doesn't trigger when you change item's slot inside inventory
function barebones:InventoryFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local unit_with_inventory_index = keys.inventory_parent_entindex_const -- -1 if not defined
	local item_index = keys.item_entindex_const
	local owner_index = keys.item_parent_entindex_const                 -- -1 if not defined
	local item_slot = keys
		.suggested_slot                                                 -- slot in which the item should be put, usually its -1 meaning put in the first free slot

	-- Item slots:
	-- Inventory slots: DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_1 - DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_9
	-- Backpack slots: DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_7 - DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_9
	-- Stash slots: DOTA_STASH_SLOT_1 - DOTA_STASH_SLOT_6
	-- Teleport scroll slot: DOTA_ITEM_TP_SCROLL = 15
	-- Neutral item slot: DOTA_ITEM_NEUTRAL_SLOT = 16
	-- Other constants:
	-- DOTA_ITEM_INVENTORY_SIZE = 9 (DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_1 = 0; DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_9 = 8)
	-- DOTA_ITEM_STASH_MIN = 9 (same as DOTA_STASH_SLOT_1)
	-- DOTA_ITEM_STASH_MAX = 15
	-- DOTA_ITEM_TRANSIENT_ITEM = 17
	-- DOTA_ITEM_TRANSIENT_RECIPE = 18
	-- DOTA_ITEM_MAX = 19
	-- DOTA_ITEM_TRANSIENT_CAST_ITEM = 20

	local unit_with_inventory
	local unit_name
	if unit_with_inventory_index and unit_with_inventory_index ~= -1 then
		unit_with_inventory = EntIndexToHScript(unit_with_inventory_index)
		unit_name = unit_with_inventory:GetUnitName()
	end

	local item
	if item_index then
		item = EntIndexToHScript(item_index)
	end
	local item_name
	if item then
		item_name = item:GetName()
	end

	local owner_of_this_item
	if owner_index and owner_index ~= -1 then
		-- not reliable
		owner_of_this_item = EntIndexToHScript(owner_index)
	elseif item then
		owner_of_this_item = item:GetPurchaser()
	end

	local owner_name
	if owner_of_this_item then
		if owner_of_this_item.GetUnitName then
			-- owner is an NPC
			owner_name = owner_of_this_item:GetUnitName()
		elseif owner_of_this_item.IsPlayer and (owner_of_this_item:IsPlayer() or owner_of_this_item:IsPlayerController()) then
			-- owner is a player
			owner_name = owner_of_this_item:GetName() -- not ideal but you get the idea
		end
	end

	return true
end

if SpawnWallManager == nil then
    SpawnWallManager = class({})
end

-- Ensure the wall modifier is registered before any wall spawns try to use it.
LinkLuaModifier("modifier_wall", "modifiers/modifier_wall", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

local function EnsureWallState(pid)
    GameState.wall_state = GameState.wall_state or {}
    if not GameState.wall_state[pid] then
        GameState.wall_state[pid] = {
            recruit_count = 0,
            extra_cols = {},
            extra_counts = {},
            base_positions = {},
            good_base_positions = {},
            extra_wall_entids = {},
        }
    end
    return GameState.wall_state[pid]
end

local function BuildExtraSet(state)
    local set = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        set[key] = true
    end
    return set
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if GameState.spawn_points[pid] then
        return GameState.spawn_points[pid]
    end

    local points = {
        good = {},
        bad = {},
        good_keys = {},
        bad_keys = {},
    }

    for i = 1, 7, 1 do
        local good_name = "spawn_point_" .. i
        local bad_name = "monster_spawn_point_" .. i
        local good_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, good_name)
        local bad_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, bad_name)
        if good_point then
            local idx = good_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.good[idx] = good_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.good_keys, idx)
        end
        if bad_point then
            local idx = bad_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.bad[idx] = bad_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.bad_keys, idx)
        end
    end

    GameState.spawn_points[pid] = points
    return points
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not GameState.walls[pid] then
        GameState.walls[pid] = {}
    end

    for key, value in pairs(points.bad) do
        local existing = GameState.walls[pid][key]
        local wall = existing and EntIndexToHScript(existing) or nil
        if wall and IsValidEntity(wall) then
            if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                wall:SetOwner(hero)
            end
        else
            local pos = Vector(value.x, 200, 135)
            wall = CreateUnitByName("npc_dota_wall_dummy", pos, false, hero, hero, DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
            if wall then
                wall:SetHullRadius(125)
                wall:AddNoDraw()
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
                wall.transfer_damage = true
                if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                    wall:SetOwner(hero)
                end
                wall.wall_owner_pid = pid
                GameState.walls[pid][key] = wall:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:InitPlayer(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    for key, pos in pairs(points.bad) do
        state.base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, 200, 135)
    end
    for key, pos in pairs(points.good) do
        state.good_base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    end
end

local function FindIndexByKey(list, key)
    if not list then
        return nil
    end
    for i, value in ipairs(list) do
        if value == key then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraGoodSlot(pid, bad_key, count)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys or not points.good_keys then
        return
    end

    local idx = FindIndexByKey(points.bad_keys, bad_key)
    if not idx then
        return
    end

    local good_key = points.good_keys[idx]
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local base = state.good_base_positions[good_key]
    if not base then
        return
    end

    local new_slot = "extra_" .. tostring(good_key) .. "_" .. tostring(count)
    if points.good[new_slot] then
        return
    end

    local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y + 250 * count, base.z)
    points.good[new_slot] = pos
    table.insert(points.good_keys, new_slot)

    if Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid] and Shop1Managers[pid].Slots then
        if Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[new_slot] == nil then
            Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[new_slot] = -1
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:ResolveTargetEntId(pid, spawn_ent_id)
    if not spawn_ent_id then
        return nil
    end

    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local extra_set = BuildExtraSet(state)

    local idx = nil
    for i, key in ipairs(points.bad_keys) do
        if key == spawn_ent_id then
            idx = i
            break
        end
    end

    if not idx then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    if not extra_set[spawn_ent_id] then
        return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][spawn_ent_id] or nil
    end

    local left_key = nil
    for i = idx - 1, 1, -1 do
        local key = points.bad_keys[i]
        if key and not extra_set[key] then
            left_key = key
            break
        end
    end

    local right_key = nil
    for i = idx + 1, #points.bad_keys do
        local key = points.bad_keys[i]
        if key and not extra_set[key] then
            right_key = key
            break
        end
    end

    local target_key = nil
    if left_key and right_key then
        target_key = (RandomInt(0, 1) == 0) and left_key or right_key
    else
        target_key = left_key or right_key or spawn_ent_id
    end

    return GameState.walls[pid] and GameState.walls[pid][target_key] or nil
end

local function BuildCandidateColumns(state, keys)
    local candidates = {}
    local has_extra = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        has_extra[key] = true
    end

    if #state.extra_cols < 2 then
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            if not has_extra[key] then
                table.insert(candidates, key)
            end
        end
    else
        for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols) do
            table.insert(candidates, key)
        end
    end

    return candidates
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraWall(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    state.extra_wall_entids = state.extra_wall_entids or {}
    local keys = points.bad_keys
    if not keys or #keys == 0 then
        return
    end

    local candidates = BuildCandidateColumns(state, keys)
    if #candidates == 0 then
        return
    end

    local key = candidates[RandomInt(1, #candidates)]
    local base = state.base_positions[key]
    if not base then
        return
    end

    local count = state.extra_counts[key] or 0
    local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y + 250 * (count + 1), 135)
    local wall = CreateUnitByName("npc_dota_wall", pos, false, hero, hero, DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
    if not wall then
        return
    end

    wall:SetOrigin(pos)

    wall:SetHullRadius(125)
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_wall", {})
    wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    wall.wall_owner_pid = pid
    table.insert(state.extra_wall_entids, wall:GetEntityIndex())


    state.extra_counts[key] = count + 1
    if count == 0 then
        table.insert(state.extra_cols, key)
    end

    self:AddExtraGoodSlot(pid, key, state.extra_counts[key])

    self:UpdateExistingMonsterTargets(pid)
end

function SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(pid, hero)
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    state.recruit_count = (state.recruit_count or 0) + 1
    if state.recruit_count % 5 ~= 0 then
        return
    end
    self:AddExtraWall(pid, hero)
end

function SpawnWallManager:ResetPlayer(pid, hero)
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    if GameState.wall_state and GameState.wall_state[pid] then
        local state = GameState.wall_state[pid]
        if state.extra_wall_entids then
            for _, entid in ipairs(state.extra_wall_entids) do
                local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entid)
                if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) then
                    unit:RemoveSelf()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local extras = Entities:FindAllByClassname("npc_dota_wall")
    for _, unit in pairs(extras) do
        if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) and unit.wall_owner_pid == pid then
            unit:RemoveSelf()
        end
    end

    local points = GameState.spawn_points and GameState.spawn_points[pid] or nil
    if points and points.good_keys then
        local new_keys = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(points.good_keys) do
            if type(key) == "string" and string.sub(key, 1, 6) == "extra_" then
                points.good[key] = nil
                if Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid] and Shop1Managers[pid].Slots then
                    Shop1Managers[pid].Slots[key] = nil
                end
            else
                table.insert(new_keys, key)
            end
        end
        points.good_keys = new_keys
    end

    GameState.wall_state = GameState.wall_state or {}
    GameState.wall_state[pid] = nil
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    state.extra_wall_entids = {}

    if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
        self:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)
        local base_points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
        if base_points then
            for key, pos in pairs(base_points.bad) do
                state.base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, 200, 135)
            end
            for key, pos in pairs(base_points.good) do
                if type(key) ~= "string" or string.sub(key, 1, 6) ~= "extra_" then
                    state.good_base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:UpdateExistingMonsterTargets(pid)
    if not SpawnManagers or not SpawnManagers[pid] then
        return
    end
    local mgr = SpawnManagers[pid]
    if not mgr.active_monsters then
        return
    end
    for entid, _ in pairs(mgr.active_monsters) do
        local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entid)
        if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) and unit.spawn_entid then
            unit.target_entid = self:ResolveTargetEntId(pid, unit.spawn_entid)
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    local count = state.recruit_count or 0
    local progress = count % 5
    local goal = 5
    return progress, goal, count
end

基于你说的“Dota2 同帧重入会闪退”的前提，按代码路径我看到这些**可能引起同帧重入/重复销毁**的入口点（不改代码，仅分析）：

- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/custom_game_mode.lua`：`CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("synthesize", ...)` 直接调用 `Shop1Managers[pid]:HandleSynthesizeByPID()`，**没有重入保护**。UI 同帧多次触发（或脚本多次触发）会让 `Synthesize()` 重入。
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/filters.lua`：`OrderFilter` 里对 `MOVE/ATTACK` 直接调用 `mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(...)`。这条路径可以在**任何订单过滤的同一帧**触发，和上面的 `synthesize` 事件叠加就会形成同帧重入。
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/shop1_manager.lua`：  
  - `Synthesize()` 内部循环里会多次调用 `SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate()`，它**当帧直接 `RemoveItem(slotA)`**。  
  - `RemoveItem()` 里立即 `stats:Destroy()` / `autocast:Destroy()`，这会触发两个 modifier 的 `OnDestroy` 同帧执行。若此时**另一个入口也在销毁同一 slot**（例如 OrderFilter 同帧也合成），就会形成双重销毁。
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/shop1_manager.lua`：`AddItemLevel()` / `AddItemLevelAll()` / `RefreshItemsForEnhance()` 都是 **当帧 RemoveItem + AddItem**，如果这些流程和 `Synthesize()` 同帧触发，会引起“先销毁、又立刻创建/销毁”的重入链。
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua`：`OnProjectileThink()` 在计时器里运行，**施法时仍在执行**。此时如果 `RemoveItem()` 销毁 `modifier_item_autocast_controller`，同帧会触发 `modifier_dummy_autocast:OnDestroy()`。这就是“施法中合成”最危险的地方：**定时器栈还在执行，对象已销毁**。

结论：  
你现在看到的“施法中合成闪退”，最符合的是 **`Synthesize/OrderFilter` 同帧重入 + RemoveItem 的双重销毁**，再叠加 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 的定时器还在跑，导致引擎级崩溃。

如果你要继续定位，我建议下一步只做**调用链梳理**（不改代码）：  
- 复现时确认是从 `synthesize` 事件还是 `OrderFilter` 触发（两条路径都能进合成）。  
- 确认同帧是否既触发 `HandleSynthesizeByPID()` 又触发 `SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated()`。

你要我帮你把这两条路径的调用链画出来（从 UI/指令 -> 函数入口 -> RemoveItem）吗？

function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,

            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    if pid then

        if p then

        return
    end

end

function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(6, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local equipName = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, lvl)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    if name == "item_invoker_deafening_blast" and tonumber(lvl) == 6 then
        print(string.format("[Shop1] AddItem invoker lvl6 -> slot %s", tostring(slot)))
    end

    name = "item_invoker_deafening_blast"

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDragMotionParams()
    return {
        max_duration = 0.75,
        min_duration = 0.25,
        max_distance = 0,
        snap_distance = 1,
        max_height = 400,
        steps = 30,
    }
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    return true, levelA

-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(6, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    if name == "item_invoker_deafening_blast" and tonumber(lvl) == 6 then
        print(string.format("[Shop1] AddItem invoker lvl6 -> slot %s", tostring(slot)))
    end

    name = "item_invoker_deafening_blast"

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDragMotionParams()
    return {
        max_duration = 0.75,
        min_duration = 0.25,

        steps = 30,
    }
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 6 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                -- self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            -- self:RemoveItem(slotB)
            self.Slots[slotB] = -1

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                    -- self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
                else
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no equipName", slotMover, slotTarget)
                end
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no hero", slotMover, slotTarget)
            end
        end)
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataA, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    if moveBoth then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataB, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    end

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToSlot(data, slot, params, onFinish)
    local pos = self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    if not pos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    self:AnimateDataToPos(data, pos, params, onFinish)

function Shop1Manager:MoveDummyToSlot(data, slot)
    if not data or not slot then return end

    local pos = self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    if not pos then return end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end

    if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp and not data.Autocast.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        data.Autocast.dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindNearestGoodSlot(pos, radius)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local nearestSlot = nil
    local nearestDist = radius or 0

    for slot, pointPos in pairs(points) do
        local dist = (pointPos - pos):Length2D()
        if dist <= nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestSlot = slot
        end
    end

    return nearestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:HandleDummyDrag(dummy, targetPos, allowOccupied)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return false end

    local currentSlot, data = self:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not currentSlot or not data then return false end
    if data.Moving then return true end
    if allowOccupied == nil then allowOccupied = true end

    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("HandleDummyDrag", currentSlot, "allowOccupied", allowOccupied, "pos", targetPos.x,
        targetPos.y)

    local targetSlot = self:FindNearestGoodSlot(targetPos, 200)
    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    if not targetSlot then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    if targetSlot == currentSlot then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    local targetData = self.Slots[targetSlot]
    local isTargetEmpty = (not targetData or targetData == -1)
    if targetData and targetData ~= -1 and targetData.Moving then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, currentSlot, motion)
        return true
    end

    if isTargetEmpty then
        self.Slots[currentSlot] = -1
        self.Slots[targetSlot] = data
        if data.Autocast then
            data.Autocast.slot = targetSlot
        end
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, targetSlot, motion)
        return true
    end

    if allowOccupied and self:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(currentSlot, targetSlot, targetSlot, false) then
        return true
    end
    if not allowOccupied then
        self:MoveDummyToSlot(data, currentSlot)
        return true
    end

    self.Slots[currentSlot] = targetData
    self.Slots[targetSlot] = data

    if data.Autocast then
        data.Autocast.slot = targetSlot
    end
    if targetData.Autocast then
        targetData.Autocast.slot = currentSlot
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(data, targetSlot, motion)
    self:AnimateDataToSlot(targetData, currentSlot, motion)
    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return
    end

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats

            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 6 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)

            return
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)
    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then return end

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 6 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do
                local slotA = table.remove(points)
                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local stats = data.Stats

    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        stats:Destroy()
    end

    local autocast = data.Autocast

    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast:Destroy()
    end

    self.Slots[slot] = -1
end

从你贴的日志可以直接判定：**不是“两条合成链路同帧重入”**，而是 **合成销毁与 Invoker 自动施法同帧交织** 导致的引擎崩溃。

关键信号（都在日志里）  
- 只有 `[SYN][OrderFilter]` 出现，**没有** `[SYN][Event]` / `[SYN][Handle]`，说明是 `OrderFilter` 路径触发（`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/filters.lua`）。  
- 在 **16.400** 同一时刻出现：  
  - `[SYN][Animated] ... time=16.400`  
  - `[SYN][RemoveItem] ... time=16.400`  
  - 紧接着 Invoker 的 `[InvokerAuto] PrepareCast...` 仍在执行  
  这说明 **销毁正好发生在自动施法逻辑进行中**（同帧重入/交织）。  
- 紧随其后出现：  
  - `Field m_flCooldownLength ... out-of-range value (-6.300000)`  
  - `Bad key for entity "npc_dota_base"... teamnumber 4294967295`  
  这是典型的 **对象被销毁后仍被引擎访问** 的症状（Native 崩溃前兆）。

直接结论  
- 同帧重入不是“synthesize 事件”和“OrderFilter”双链叠加。  
- 真正的重入点是：`OrderFilter -> SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated -> RemoveItem` 与 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 的施法/队列逻辑 **在同一帧交织**。  
- “只销毁 1 个 item 仍会闪退”也解释通：**只要销毁的这个 item 正在施法，就会触发崩溃**。

可指向的代码位置  
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/filters.lua`：`OrderFilter` 直接调用 `SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated`  
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/shop1_manager.lua`：`SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated -> RemoveItem` 同帧执行  
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua`：`OnProjectileThink/PrepareCast` 同帧仍在跑

下一步（如果继续定位）  
1) 继续保留当前日志，复现时**只看 time=16.xxx**，验证 `RemoveItem` 与 `PrepareCast` 是否必然在同一帧  
2) 如果要根治，就必须让“销毁”与“施法”分帧（或销毁前强制停止施法/清队列）

你要我给出**最小改动的修复方案**（分帧销毁或销毁前停止施法）吗？

@@
 function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
     local data = self.Slots[slot]
     if not data or data == -1 then
         self.Slots[slot] = -1
         return
     end
     local dummy_name = self:GetDummyUnitName(data) or "nil"
     local level = self:GetDataLevel(data) or "nil"
     print(string.format("[SYN][RemoveItem] pid=%s slot=%s dummy=%s lvl=%s time=%.3f",
         tostring(self.pid), tostring(slot), tostring(dummy_name), tostring(level), GameRules:GetGameTime()))
     self.Slots[slot] = -1
 
     local stats = data.Stats
     local autocast = data.Autocast
 
+    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
+    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
+        local mod = dummy:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
+        if mod then
+            mod.is_paused = true
+        end
+        if dummy.Stop then
+            dummy:Stop()
+        end
+        if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
+            dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
+        end
+    end
+
     if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
         autocast.is_paused = true
         local parent = autocast:GetParent()
         if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
             if parent.Stop then
                 parent:Stop()
@@

         if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
             stats:Destroy()
         end
         if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
             autocast:Destroy()
         end
         return nil
     end)
 end
*** End Patch

There is a lot here! I'm working through logs and code behavior to explain why previous fixes didn’t prevent crashes: it looks like queued ability orders on destroyed dummy units and UI selection referencing invalid entities cause these persistent issues. I plan to suggest stronger fixes like clearing queued orders explicitly before dummy removal, adding guard clauses in selection updates to ignore base entities, and blocking ability casts or order queueing during synthesis phases. I’m outlining a minimal fix to prevent crashes by cancelling queued orders on dummies before destruction and blocking new queued orders during dummy removal. This involves setting a destroying flag on the dummy, issuing a stop order via `ExecuteOrderFromTable`, optionally calling `dummy:Interrupt()`, and checking this flag in `PrepareCast` and projectile timers to halt further actions. This approach should stop stale orders from executing on destroyed dummies, explaining why previous pauses weren’t enough. I’ll implement this with careful flag checks and minimal behavior changes to address the user’s request for a concrete fix.

结论先说清楚：**去掉 invoker 的特殊处理并不能消除崩溃，因为真正触发施法的是 `modifier_dummy_autocast`，它仍会让 dummy 施放 `invoker_chaos_meteor`。**  
所以崩溃源头并不是 invoker handler，而是**“销毁中的 dummy/ability 仍被引擎当帧使用”**。

**为什么之前处理没效果**
- 你只去掉了 invoker special handler，但 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 仍在 `ExecuteOrderFromTable` 让 dummy 施法（同帧执行）。  
  相关代码：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua`
- 延迟销毁 + 停止施法仍可能失败，因为**已发出的 Order 仍然在引擎队列里**，而你销毁了相关 unit/ability；这会导致  
  `m_flCooldownLength out-of-range`、`teamnumber 4294967295` 这类 **“访问已销毁实体”** 的典型症状。
- 日志里显示 **同一帧内发生 RemoveItem 与施法**（`time=20.067` 之类），说明 **销毁和施法交织仍在发生**。
- 另外，`SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated` 只 RemoveItem slotA，但日志里 slotB 也被 RemoveItem，说明**另一路径也在销毁**（同帧重入或重复销毁），这会进一步放大崩溃概率。  
  相关代码：`game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/shop1_manager.lua`

定位结论已经非常明确：

1) **不是同一实例被重复销毁**  
- `entA=222`、`entB=238`  
- 两次 `RemoveItem` 的 `stats/autocast` 也是不同指针  
这说明 **销毁的是两个不同 dummy**，不是“双重销毁同一实例”。

2) **崩溃触发点在 UI/selection/WorldPanel 访问已销毁实体**  
- `OnShop1DummySelection`、`[WP JS] Updating stars for ID: 997` 紧跟在销毁之后  
- 随后立刻出现 `npc_dota_base teamnumber 4294967295`  
这就是 **UI/selection 使用了已经被 Destroy 的 entindex** 的典型崩溃方式。

所以“真正原因”是：  
**合成销毁 dummy 后，Selection 或 WorldPanel 仍在用旧 entindex 更新（尤其是 stars 更新），引擎访问已销毁实体导致崩溃。**  
Invoker 只是更容易触发，因为它施法导致合成更频繁/更容易在同一帧发生。

如果你允许修复，方向很清晰：  
- 销毁 dummy 前先确保 **UI/selection 不再引用**它（清除 selection，清除 world panel 绑定）  
- 或者 **延迟销毁 dummy，等 UI 更新完成**  
- 或者在 JS/UI 侧 **忽略无效 entindex**

你现在要我按这个原因做修复吗？

WORLDPANELS_VERSION = "0.81"

--[[
  Lua-controlled Frankenstein WorldPanels Library by BMD

  Installation
  -"require" this file inside your code in order to make the WorldPanels API availble
  -Ensure that this file is placed in the vscripts/libraries path along with timers.lua and playertables.lua
  -Ensure that you have the barebones_worldpanels.xml in your panorama content layout folder.
  -Ensure that you have the barebones_worldpanels.js in your panorama content scripts folder.
  -Ensure that barebones_worldpanels.xml is included in your custom_ui_manifest.xml with
    <CustomUIElement type="Hud" layoutfile="file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/barebones_worldpanels.xml" />

  Library Usage
  -WorldPanels are a means of displaying panorama layout files to individuals which act as though they are positioned at a specific point in the world
    or on a specific entity.
  -WorldPanels can be shared with an individual player, a whole team, or all clients at once via
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanel(playerID, configTable) -- 1 player or array of playerIDs like {3,5,8}
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForTeam(teamID, configTable) -- 1 team
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll(configTable) -- All players
  -WorldPanels are specified by a configuration table which has several potential parameters:
    -layout: The panorama layout file to display in this worldpanel.
    -position: Mutually exclusive with "entity".  Position is the world vector position to display the worldpanel at.
    -entity: Mutually exclusive with "position".  Entity is the entity (hscript or index) which the worldpanel will track for its position.
    -offsetX: An optional (default is 0) screen pixel offset to apply to the worldpanel (in the x direction)
    -offsetY: An optional (default is 0) screen pixel offset to apply to the worldpanel (in the y direction)
    -horizontalAlign: An optional (default is "center") alignment for the worldpanel to use when adjusting the panel size. "center", "left", "right" are valid options
    -verticalAlign: An optional (default is "bottom") alignment for the worldpanel to use when adjusting the panel size. "bottom", "center", "top" are valid options
    -entityHeight: An optional (default is 0) height offset to use for the entity world panel (see: "HealthBarOffset" in unit KV definition)
    -edgePadding: An optional (default is to not lock to screen edge) padding percentage of the screen to limit the worldpanel to.
    -duration: An optional (default is infinite) duration in GameTime seconds that the panel will exist for and then be automatically destroyed.
    -data: An optional table of data which will be attached to the worldpanel so that valeus can be used in javascript through $.GetContextPanel().Data
      This table should only contain numeric, string, or table values (no entities/hscripts)

  -WorldPanels returned by the Create methods have the following methods:
    wp:SetPosition(position)
    wp:SetEntity(entity)
    wp:SetHorizontalAlign(hAlign)
    wp:SetVerticalAlign(vAlign)
    wp:SetOffsetX(offsetX)
    wp:SetOffsetY(offsetY)
    wp:SetEdgePadding(edge)
    wp:SetEntityHeight(entityHeight)
    wp:SetData(data)
    wp:Delete()

  -See examples/worldpanelsExample.lua for usage examples.


  Notes
  -WorldPanel panorama performance can still be an issue (depending on layout).  Use sparingly.
  -A WorldPanel attached to an entity will only show when the player has vision of that entity
  -A WorldPanel is automatically deleted if the entity it is attached to dies (and is not a hero type unit)
  -Edge tracking is currently inaccurate in certain sitautions due to a valve bug with Game.WorldToScreenX/Y
  -The WorldPanel library provides a few helpful properties for use in your layout file's javascript.
    $.GetContextPanel().WorldPanel      contains the WorldPanel configuration in the following table format:
      {layout, offsetX, offsetY, position, entity, entityHeight, hAlign, vAlign, edge}
    $.GetContextPanel().OnEdge          true if this worldpanel has edgelocking/padding and is touching the edge/padded edge of the screen.  false otherwise.  Updates every frame.
    $.GetContextPanel().OffScreen       true if this worldpanel has no edgelocking/padding and is completely off screen.  false otherwise.  Updates every frame.
    $.GetContextPanel().Data            the "data" object passed in to CreateWorldPanel.

  Examples
  -Create a special worldpanel for the hero entity of player 0, only visible to player 0. Adds 210 to the unit position for the height of the panel.

      {layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/healthbar.xml",
        entity = PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(0),
        entityHeight = 210,
      })

  -Create a worldpanel for all players that displays at 200 height above the ground at Vector(0,0,0) and locks to 5% of the dge of the screen 
    WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll(
      {layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/arrow.xml",
        position = GetGroundPosition(Vector(0,0,0), nil) + Vector(0,0,200),
